system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global aridity-index climatology in WGS84 at 30 arc-second resolution. The monthly asset is organized as one climatological layer per calendar month rather than as a historical monthly timeline.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Twelve monthly climatology layers for the 1970-2000 climate baseline, indexed by calendar month rather than observation date.

band_semantics.b1: Aridity-index raster for the calendar month encoded by `system:index`.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection indexes one climatological layer per calendar month rather than a long historical sequence.
analytical_capabilities: Combination with vegetation, crop, or soil datasets

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Monthly aridity-index values by calendar month; check the exact scaling convention against the source docs before numeric comparison.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the image index suffix (`01`-`12`) as the month indicator because explicit timestamps were not exposed in the runtime metadata.

data_description.data_source: CGIAR Platform for Big Data in Agriculture via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
